pick.name: Stripe (official plugin)
pick.why: Official vendor plugin from the most widely used payments provider; maintained in the official marketplace

alts.name: Razorpay MCP
alts.what: Official Razorpay MCP: payments, links, refunds, settlements; READ_ONLY flag
alts.why: Best if billing runs on Razorpay (India)

alts.name: Merchant-of-record MCPs (Dodo/Polar/Paddle)
alts.why: Pick when the MoR handles tax

candidates.name: MoR MCPs
candidates.verdict: if using a merchant of record

candidates.name: PayPal MCP
candidates.verdict: useful when PayPal is required; not opened

decision: Use the MCP from whichever provider actually bills you; Stripe's official plugin is the default pick given adoption. Always use test-mode keys and read-only flags, and never put live secret keys in MCP config.
details: Previously matched a single provider; now Stripe-led with provider-matching advice.

region_notes.India: Razorpay and other local gateways are common for INR billing; use the Razorpay MCP if that is your processor.
region_notes.EU: Merchant-of-record services (Paddle, Polar, Dodo) can handle VAT; verify with a tax professional.

verify.note: Shallow check: no neutrality, pricing or licence defect found; not re-fetched.
